links.outcome: Readability grade level of papers before and after ChatGPT plain-language simplification; ophthalmologist appropriateness
links.effect: Readability fell from 15th to 7th grade (P<.001), and expert ophthalmologists judged the simplified responses appropriate. The output was still above the 6th-grade target.
links.quote: ChatGPT significantly lowered the readability and length of the selected papers from 15th to 7th grade (P<.001) while generating responses that were deemed appropriate by expert ophthalmologists.

screen.reason: Evaluates using ChatGPT with an explicit 6th-grade reading-level prompt constraint to simplify peer-reviewed ophthalmology papers for patients, measured by readability metrics and expert clinician review.

primary.practice: reading-level prompt constraint for patient comprehension
